title: Large Language Models Can Infer Psychological Dispositions of Social Media Users

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy of LLM-inferred Big Five personality scores by analyzing the mean differences and residuals between self-reported and inferred scores for male versus female users based on their Facebook status updates.
